name: insert each element into the sorted prefix
mechanism: grow an ordered prefix one element at a time by finding where the next element belongs among the ordered ones and shifting to make room

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Insertion sort' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting: determine where the current item belongs in the list of sorted ones, and insert it there

fails_when: quadratic shifts on far-from-sorted input (gap sequences and gaps in storage are the repairs)
